description: The REMOT Project includes members Teresa, Riwon, Max, Evan and Olivia! Together, we have designed a game prototype for everyone to access the chance to build their own space mission and city, with the objective to build a sustainable area. Accept the challenge and travel through space, exploring the deepest parts of your creativity! https://canva.link/g5sr273wffc29hx
summary: REMOT created a prototype of a space mission. The prototype addresses the challenge NASA provided by allowing the player to travel and research different planets. It is important because the players learn to grow colonies on the planets despite challenges such as radiation storms and resource shortages.
details: SPACE MISSION allows players to work together to create growing colonies on planets within the milky way. It intends to teach users information about the universe and different planets, benefiting their overall knowledge. REMOT used Canva to develop part of the prototype, considering factors allowing it to be easy to use and understand, while still making it fun and educational.
